title: Grazia Stones: Wall Cladding
short: Browse stone wall cladding, view it in 3D, calculate boxes and request a quote.
full:
Grazia Stones is the complete catalogue for premium stone wall cladding. Explore 35 collections and 95+ designs of natural and cultured stone, brick, ledge stone, 3D wall panels and patina panels for homes, hotels, restaurants, offices and facades. Built for homeowners, architects, interior designers and contractors across India.

WHAT YOU CAN DO

• Browse the full catalogue
Exclusive Patina, Premium CNC, Premium 3D Surface, Design Surface, Brick Series and Ledge Series. Every design shows size, thickness, finish and box coverage.

• See every colour, zoom in, view in 3D
Pick a colour and the photo changes with it. Open any design full screen to pinch and zoom, or turn the 3D slab to see its real thickness from every side.

• Wall and Tile Visualizer
Enter your wall size, choose a design and a laying pattern, and see it in 3D with the real tile size. Get net area, wastage and the number of boxes you need.

• Project calculator
Quick box and area estimate for any wall, in feet or metres.

• Request a quote
Choose one or many designs, add your area and city, and send an enquiry. The Grazia team confirms the final price and availability.

• Request physical samples
Order sample swatches so you can see and feel the stone before you decide.

• Live AR camera (supported phones)
Point your camera at a wall to preview a design in your space on ARCore supported devices.

• Ask Aarna, your design assistant
Describe your room in English or Hinglish and get design ideas and the right Grazia collection for it.

• Showrooms and dealers
Find the Grazia experience centres in Kanpur, Gurugram and Lucknow, call the desk and get directions.

• Wishlist and projects
Save designs and build a project list to quote together.

GOOD TO KNOW
• Prices in the app are indicative. Final price, availability and delivery are confirmed in your quote.
• The app does not take payments. Quotes and payments are arranged directly with Grazia Stones.
• Browse as a guest, or sign in with email or Google to save your wishlist and requests.
• You can delete your account and data any time from Profile, then Delete Account.

ABOUT GRAZIA STONES
Grazia Stones (a unit of BNK Stones) is an architectural stone brand based in Kanpur, Uttar Pradesh, crafting natural and cultured stone cladding for homes, hotels, restaurants and commercial projects across India. From Nature to Luxury.

Support: contactgraziastones@gmail.com
Office: 123/477, Kalpi Road, Fazalganj, Kanpur, UP 208012

App built and powered by RAGSPRO (ragspro.com).
notes: Live AR keeps every wall you point at: turn to a second wall or a room corner and both get stone, and you can choose Wall A, Wall B or both. Stone is never drawn over the whole screen when the wall edge is unclear. Size the wall with a tape: tap the 4 corners of something you measured and enter it in cm or inches.
